title: Kinematics-resolved step-over & tensile horsetail termination graph with strike-normal potential-field gradient projection and out-of-fold empirical-Bayes posterior calibration
lane: GEMSDOE69 — relay-ramp and pull-apart corridor generator

holdout_instrument.split: vendor/template66 gems57.holdout.buffered_component_draw (whole 8-connected components, hide_frac=0.20, feature_buffer_px=3 [300 m], boundary_buffer_px=12 [1.2 km], 4 quadrants NW/NE/SW/SE per draw)
holdout_instrument.evaluator: vendor/template66 gems57.evaluate_holdout (gems57-pooled-hide-v2; alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, R=300 m triangular kernel; pixel-exact known-fault masking; paired spatial-block bootstrap CI)
holdout_instrument.secondary_screen: repaired src/gems69/holdout69.py (with IR-69-17 fixed: offvis computed strictly from cell visible catalogue, never full catalogue)

geometry_specification.polylines: INGENIOUS Quaternary fault segments (external/trace_segments_utm11.csv) joined 1:1 by record_id to external/qfault_attributes.csv (recorded DIPDIRECT and slip sense RL/LL/N) plus DEM hanging-wall polarity fallback (external/geodawn_dem_a2_100m.tif at 600 m and 1.2 km offsets) validated on recorded normal faults; clipped strictly to visible traces in every holdout fold
geometry_specification.dip_rule: reject normal-fault pairs with opposite hanging-wall dip vectors (dot(dip_vec_a, dip_vec_b) < 0)
geometry_specification.slip_sense_rule: reject restraining steps on recorded strike-slip strands (RL with cross_step < 0; LL with cross_step > 0); classify releasing strike-slip steps and NW transtensional right steps as pullapart, synthetic normal steps as relay
geometry_specification.terminations_and_transfers: emit tensile horsetail splays at free strike-slip terminations (26.5 deg and 45 deg into extensional quadrant), tensile tip continuations and WNW-dilatational wing splays at free normal tips, and displacement-transfer connectors to nearby oblique strands (<=4.0 km)

scoring_specification.grav_perp: 0.55 * rank01(|grad_300m(iso_grav_anom) . n_corridor|) + 0.45 * grav_edge (upward-continued 200m/600m/1800m THDR x tilt zero-crossing)
scoring_specification.mag_perp: 0.55 * rank01(|grad_300m(rtp) . n_corridor|) + 0.45 * mag_edge (upward-continued 200m/600m/1800m THDR x tilt zero-crossing)
scoring_specification.joint_conv: min(grav_perp, mag_perp) — convergent density + magnetization step across corridor normal
scoring_specification.mag_low: rank01(-(RTP - Gaussian_3km(RTP))) — hydrothermal magnetite destruction along permeable damage zones
scoring_specification.dilation_tendency: cos^2(azimuth_deg - 22.5 deg) under Walker Lane WNW (112.5 deg) extension

calibration_and_allocation.calibration: 3-level hierarchical empirical-Bayes shrinkage fitted strictly out-of-fold on visible training quadrants: base rate p0 -> distance-to-visible rate r1(d_vis) [m_v=100] -> geometry rate r2(d_vis, d_line, d_tip) [m_g=250] -> full physics+score rate r3(d_vis, d_line, d_tip, s_band, e_pix) [m_f=350]
calibration_and_allocation.allocator: 3x3 kernel-spacing tile decimation (gems57.emit.emit_decimated, tile_px=3) + exact greedy marginal-DTI bar selection (gems57.emit.greedy_allocate, k_truth=12226 live / K_TRUTH_RATIO*visible holdout)

gates.leakage_canary: every single feature and out-of-fold corridor feature AUC <= 0.90 on untouched holdout
gates.hardlink_recovery: mask linking fault in hard-linked catalogue ramps; require 300 m recall > null p95
gates.science_gate: pooled HOLDOUT-DTI(A_corridor) > pooled HOLDOUT-DTI(B1_halo) with paired spatial-block 95% CI lower bound > 0 on untouched draws (22, 23)
gates.current_best_gate: pooled HOLDOUT-DTI(A_corridor) beats all prior checked-in GEMSDOE69 holdout arms on identical shared evaluator
gates.uniqueness_gate: strict literal release_gate.py enforced without modification: |Spearman rho| <= 0.90 AND literal all-registry 3-px dot overlap <= 0.70 required for public download; if literal overlap fires on whole-footprint soft surfaces, archive candidate TIF as negative result with DO NOT SUBMIT banner and zero slot used
